tools.name: run_development_calculator
tools.description: Analyze a commercial-to-residential property development deal. Calculates GDV, gross development costs (including 15% contingency), development finance capacity (max LTC 80% / max LTV-GDV 65%), equity required, arrangement fee, finance interest, and two exit scenarios (sell vs hold/refinance). Optionally models a third exit via a supported housing lease. Returns viability flag and gross development margin percentage. Use when the user provides a purchase price, build cost, unit count, and end values.

purchase_price.description: Purchase price of the commercial building in GBP.

build_cost_per_unit.description: Average construction/conversion cost per residential unit in GBP.

unit_count.description: Number of residential units the building will yield.

average_unit_value.description: Average completed unit sale value in GBP (for GDV calculation).

average_monthly_rent.description: Average monthly rent per unit in GBP (for the hold/refinance exit analysis).

professional_fees.description: Total professional fees in GBP (architect, structural engineer, QS, legal etc). Default 50000 if not specified.

project_months.description: Expected project duration in months. Default 18.

finance_rate_monthly.description: Monthly development finance rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.0105 = 1.05%). Default 0.0105.

exit_preference.description: Which exits to return in detail. Default both.

supported_housing_exit.description: Whether to model a supported housing (guaranteed exit) scenario.

supported_housing_monthly_rent.description: Monthly rent per unit under a supported housing lease (GBP). Required if supported_housing_exit is true.

supported_housing_lease_years.description: Supported housing lease duration in years. Default 15.

Collect these values from the user conversationally before calling.

available_capital.description: Total capital available to invest in GBP.

monthly_income_target.description: Monthly passive income target in GBP.

hands_on_preference.description: How much time/involvement the user wants. Low = passive, high = very active.

sequence_slug.description: The slug identifier of the communication sequence (e.g. "investor-follow-up-30d").

contact_ids.description: Array of contact IDs to enroll. Maximum 50 per call.

context_note.description: Optional note explaining why these contacts are being enrolled (for audit log).

tools.name: write_to_scratchpad
tools.description: Save an intermediate result, calculation output, or working note to the session scratchpad under a named key. Use this when you have completed one sub-task within a multi-step analysis and want to preserve the result before continuing. You can read it back later with read_from_scratchpad. Keys should be short, descriptive, and kebab-case (e.g., "property-1-deal-analysis", "structure-recommendation", "compliance-summary"). Values can be prose, a JSON string, or any text you want to recall later. Overwriting an existing key replaces its value entirely.

key.description: Kebab-case identifier for this scratchpad entry, e.g. "property-1-gdv" or "compliance-summary". Max 100 characters.

value.description: The content to store. Can be prose, structured text, or a JSON-encoded object. Max 10,000 characters.
